properties.name: Nilambazar
properties.source: Location from OpenStreetMap contributors; flood level from NodiBondhu HAND model
properties.quality: Screening estimate only. Terrain is a surface model with several metres of vertical error on flat land. Ignores embankments, flow, timing and channel changes. Compared with one radar image of the July 2026 flood and only partly matches it, so higher scenarios are likely too large. Only land inside the district boundary is counted, not land in Bangladesh
